Entire subject visible with a few transparent margin pixels, transparent RGBA background. One magnificent ancient broadleaf OAK TREE, entire crown and root base visible. About 6.5 meters tall with a broad irregular asymmetric rounded canopy and stout old branching trunk. Dense overlapping irregular lobes of naturally muted moss-green and olive foliage with a few slightly warm leaves, leaf clusters describe three-dimensional volume with dark cool gaps within crown. Beautiful old spreading branch architecture, gnarled fissured grey-brown bark, visible solid trunk occupying the bottom third, substantial weathered spreading roots. Crown is wider than trunk and not a perfect ball; a slightly broken opening on the right. A healthy dense temperate forest oak, not a bonsai, not a willow, not tropical. No grass tufts or ground at base, no detached fallen leaves. Mid-value natural albedo and subtle highlight clusters, no baked sunlight.
